title: 5 Day Private Camping Tarangire Serengeti & Ngorongoro Crater
description: Experience an unforgettable 5-day private camping safari in Tanzania, exploring three of the country's most iconic wildlife destinations: Tarangire National Park, Serengeti National Park and the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater. This adventure is designed for travellers seeking an authentic African wilderness experience, combining landscapes, wildlife encounters and nights under the African sky. Discover Tarangire's elephant herds and ancient baobab trees before exploring the endless plains of Serengeti.

Enjoy game drives in search of the African Big Five, including elephants, lions, leopards, buffaloes and the endangered black rhino. Explore the Serengeti's plains in search of big cats, and, depending on your travel season, follow the Great Wildebeest Migration as thousands of wildebeest and zebras move across the ecosystem in search of fresh grazing and water. Your adventure concludes inside Ngorongoro Crater.

Travel in your own private 4x4 safari Land Cruiser with a professional safari guide. A dedicated safari cook prepares fresh meals throughout your adventure, and all essential camping equipment is provided, including sleeping tents, mattresses, sleeping bags, pillows, camping tables, chairs and cooking equipment.
highlights: A full day in the Serengeti dedicated to big cats and the Great Migration
Tarangire's elephant herds and baobab trees

Search for the Big Five, including the endangered black rhino

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.text:
After breakfast in Arusha, meet your professional safari guide and depart for Tarangire National Park, famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and beautiful savannah landscapes. Upon arrival, begin your game drive through the park, discovering one of Tanzania's most remarkable wildlife ecosystems.

Explore different areas of Tarangire in search of elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes and numerous bird species. The Tarangire River is an important water source, attracting wildlife, particularly during the dry season. Your guide will explain the behaviour of different animal species. Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the park before continuing your afternoon game drive.

In the late afternoon, exit the park and proceed to your campsite for dinner and overnight. Enjoy your first camping experience, surrounded by the African wilderness, and prepare for the journey to Serengeti the following morning.

itinerary.title: Tarangire to Serengeti National Park: discover the endless plains
itinerary.text:
After an early breakfast, depart for Serengeti National Park, travelling through the spectacular landscapes of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Along the way, enjoy views of the volcanic highlands, open grasslands and traditional Maasai communities. As you approach Serengeti, the scenery gradually transforms into endless golden plains dotted with acacia trees and rocky kopjes.

Upon entering Serengeti National Park, begin your game drive through one of Africa's most famous wildlife destinations. Explore the endless plains in search of the African Big Five and magnificent predators, particularly lions, leopards and cheetahs. You may also encounter elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, hyenas and many other species. Depending on your travel season, your guide will focus on areas with good opportunities to encounter the Great Wildebeest Migration.

Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive, taking advantage of the photography opportunities and wildlife encounters. In the late afternoon, proceed to your campsite for dinner and overnight, surrounded by the sounds of the African wilderness.

itinerary.title: Full-day game drive in Serengeti: follow the Great Migration
itinerary.text:
Wake up early and enjoy breakfast before heading out for a full-day wildlife adventure in Serengeti. Today is dedicated to exploring the park's plains, with a special focus on its famous big cats: lions, leopards and cheetahs.

Depending on your travel season, your guide will take you towards the areas where the Great Wildebeest Migration is moving. Observe thousands of wildebeest and zebras searching for fresh grazing and water. You may also encounter hyenas, elephants, giraffes and other wildlife following the migrating herds. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness.

Continue your afternoon game drive, with your guide selecting the best areas according to recent sightings and seasonal animal movements. In the evening, return to your campsite for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park to the Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, enjoy a morning game drive in Serengeti as you gradually begin your journey towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. This is another opportunity to explore the plains, search for wildlife and enjoy the scenery of Serengeti before leaving the park.

Continue towards the Ngorongoro Highlands, passing through landscapes where open savannah plains gradually transform into rolling hills, volcanic scenery and lush highland vegetation. Your guide will share information about the region's ecosystem and traditional Maasai communities.

Arrive at your campsite in the Ngorongoro Highlands during the afternoon. Settle into your camping arrangements, enjoy a freshly prepared dinner from your safari cook, and relax as you prepare for the following day's Ngorongoro Crater experience. An early night is recommended for the crater descent ahead.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater game drive and departure
itinerary.text:
After an early breakfast, depart for the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa's most remarkable natural wildlife destinations. Descend approximately 600 metres into the crater for a game drive across its beautiful landscape. The crater is home to an extraordinary concentration of wildlife, making it one of the best places in Tanzania to search for the African Big Five.

Explore the crater floor in search of lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos, hyenas and the endangered black rhino. Your guide will take you through different habitats, including open grasslands, woodland, swamps and lakes, with excellent opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a designated picnic site surrounded by the crater scenery.

In the afternoon, ascend the crater walls and begin your return journey to Arusha, Moshi, Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, depending on your departure arrangements. Your guide will ensure a comfortable transfer according to your flight schedule, bringing your five-day private camping safari to a conclusion.

summary: A 5-day private camping safari with a full day in the Serengeti following the Great Migration, plus Tarangire's elephants and a game drive in Ngorongoro Crater.
